Sound does not travel through empty space
Sound travels through solids, liquids, and gases
Sound speed depends on the material medium
Sound is described by wavelength, frequency, speed, amplitude, intensity, loudness, and pi
Higher frequency corresponds to shorter wavelength; lower frequency to longer wavelength
Loudness is related to amplitude or intensity; pitch is related to frequency
Sound has applications such as SONAR and ultrasound
